name: @toros/adapters-machine
description: T2 read-only machine inventory adapter — reports readiness of known adapters/tools on this node
_comment_entrypoints: tsconfig sets rootDir '.' so that src/ and test/ both compile, which puts the emitted entrypoint at dist/src/index.js — not dist/index.js. These paths must match that layout or every consumer fails with TS2307 'Cannot find module @toros/adapters-machine'.
